_note: Closed vocabulary: rules (hand-written or LLM-compiled) may only reference these names. Units: torso = mid-hip to mid-shoulder length; angles in degrees; L/R = the baby's anatomical left/right.

window.computed_on: RAW keypoints (before One-Euro/low-pass), distal joints (wrists, ankles) in the body frame; fast band = 4-14 Hz band-pass, 2 s Hann windows, 0.5 s hop; slow band = 0.4-6 Hz, 4 s windows, 1 s hop

peak_hz.def: frequency of the largest spectral peak in the band's search range (parabolic interpolation)

prominence_db.def: peak power over the median power of the reference band, excluding +-excl Hz around the peak

rhythmicity.def: autocorrelation of the band-passed 2-D signal at a lag of one period of peak_hz

amp_p2p.def: peak-to-peak amplitude of the narrow-band component at the peak (2*sqrt(2*band variance))

contra_ratio.def: power of the homologous limb in the same window at the same frequency / this limb's peak-band power

rigid_r2.def: fraction of band-passed multi-joint image motion explained by one per-frame similarity transform (camera shake / whole-frame motion test)

camera_rms.def: RMS of the band-passed torso centroid in image space

valid_frac.def: fraction of frames in the window where the joint was detected

frame.computed_on: lightly smoothed keypoints (0.2 s moving average; in the app: One-Euro output) in the body frame; valid only for context 'supine' top-down views

head_yaw_sin.def: (nose - ear midpoint).u / head radius; >0 face turned to the baby's left

head_tilt_deg.def: eye line vs shoulder line angle; >0 head tilted toward the baby's right shoulder; NaN when |yaw|>0.5

thigh_abd_L.def: angle of hip->knee vs the caudal torso axis, positive laterally

thigh_flat_L.def: projected thigh length / its session 90th percentile (~1 = thigh lying in the image plane)

knee_spread.def: (left knee u - right knee u) / hip width

ankle_cross.def: left ankle u - right ankle u (<0 = legs crossed)

hands_mid_u.def: max |u| of the two wrists (distance from body midline)

face_side_elbow.def: elbow angle on the side the face is turned to

occiput_side_elbow.def: elbow angle on the opposite side

min_thigh_abd.def: min of both sides (NaN if either missing)

posture.observed_s: seconds where every frame-predicate feature was valid
posture.leg_active_frac: mean active fraction of both legs (hysteresis on distal speed, noise-adaptive)
posture.arm_active_frac: mean active fraction of both arms

posture_side.observed_s: seconds with a valid side signal

activity.arm_asym_index: (L - R)/(L + R) of distal path length per observed minute
activity.arm_min_observed_s: min observed seconds of the two arms
activity.arm_active_s: active seconds summed over both arms

burst.largest_cluster: events in the largest cluster whose median interval <= max_median_interval_s
burst.n_sudden: events that were sudden (quiet before), bilateral and axial
burst.cluster_median_interval_s: median onset interval in that cluster
burst.cluster_interval_cv: coefficient of variation of the intervals
burst.surrogate_p: share of limb-wise circular-shift surrogates with a cluster at least as large

not_observable_with_coco17: trunk arching in a top-down view (out of plane)
